Ahead of India's Budget 2024, a Look at the History of Budgets | Flashback With Palki Sharma
India is days away from the first budget of prime minister Narendra Modi's third term. Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman, who has presented six budgets, will set a record for most consecutive budget presentations on Tuesday. But what is the history of budgets in India? How and why did Indian governments start making budgets? Palki Sharma tells you on Flashback.
